definitions.usage: bind, be dumb, put to silence.
definitions.full: H481. alam [ אָלַם ] verb bind (perhaps compare Assyrian [ al¹mu ], almattu , fortress Dl in Zim BP 114 & in BD Ezek.:xi ; Arabic be in pain , Aramaic retain anger). Niph`al ( be bound =) be dumb, Perfect 3feminine singular נֶאֱלָ֑מָה Isa 53:7 ; וְנֶאֱלַמְתָּ֫ Ezek 3:26 , etc.; Imperfect 2masculine singular תֵּאָלֵם 24:27 ; 3 feminine plural תֵּאָלַמְנָה Psa 31:19 . — 1 be dumb , i.e. silent 39:3 ׳נ דוּמִיָּה (|| הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי ); compare 39:10 (|| אֶפְתַּחמִּֿי לֹא ); simile of sheep Isa 53:7 (|| id. ); be dumb , i.e. unable to speak Ezek 3:26 (result of אֶלחִֿכָּ֑ךָ אַדְבִּיק וּלְשׁוֺנְךָ ) compare 24:27 עוֺד תֵאָלֵם וְלֹא וּתְדַבֵּר ֗֗֗ מִּיךָ יִמָּתַח ; 33:22 עוֺד נֶאֱלַמְתִּי וְלֹא מִּי וַיִּפְתַּח ; also Dan 10:15 (compare 10:16 ); be made dumb subject שָׁ֑קֶר שִׂפְתֵי lying lips Psa 31:19 (|| לִשְׁאוֺל יִדְּמוּ 31:18 ). Pi`el Participle bind Gen 37:7 (E) אֲלֻמִּים מְאַלְּמִים binding sheaves .
